subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core accept built-in Control UI math rendering, and which renderer/config/security boundary should be the supported product contract?
rationale: The issue is not a narrow bug fix: it may add a public config key, dependency or bundled asset, and sanitizer behavior for untrusted chat output, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Sponsor a hardened core path
options.body: Pick a renderer and default/config shape, require sanitizer/dependency review plus browser proof, and use one current PR or a narrow replacement as the implementation vehicle.

options.title: Defer pending renderer comparison
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers compare KaTeX, MathJax, and the linked MathML compiler approach before accepting a dependency or sanitizer boundary.

options.title: Reject core rendering for now
options.body: Close the canonical issue and candidate PRs if maintainers decide equation rendering should remain outside core until a plugin/API surface exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a hardened core path
recommendation.body: Pick a renderer and default/config shape, require sanitizer/dependency review plus browser proof, and use one current PR or a narrow replacement as the implementation vehicle.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security acceptance choice and steipete is the listed project owner with adjacent Control UI markdown history.
